highlights.title: macOS may ask about Kosmos once
highlights.line: Kosmos is now one app that we sign and Apple notarizes, so after this update macOS may ask once more for permissions you gave it.

highlights.title: Messages wait for an agent out of usage
highlights.line: When a Claude agent is out of usage, Kosmos usually holds your direct messages to it and most from other agents until the limit resets.

highlights.title: Pick the language your agents write in
highlights.line: Settings, Automation, Language asks your agents to write to you in the language you pick.

highlights.title: Reply to Claude questions by number
highlights.line: When a Claude agent asks you to pick one option, replying with its number reaches it as your answer, not the highlighted default.

highlights.title: Kosmos fits a phone screen better
highlights.line: On a phone, a project's name gets two lines, its message box hint fits, and Settings' Community section fits most phone screens.
